title: Docs bundle
description: The JSON files of the docs bundle (latest.json, manifest.json, search.json). Shipped in the bundle as schema.json. Fields listed under `required` are always present; the others are optional and omitted, never null, when they do not apply (exception: PageEntry.parent is always present and is null at the top level).

section.description: A closed set. Every page, and every navigation node (folder nodes included), carries exactly one. The build fails on a value outside this list.

route.description: Site route without base; the home page is the empty string

source.description: Repo path of the Markdown file

updated.description: Date of the file's last commit

summary.description: First paragraph as plain text, at most 220 characters. When longer it is cut at a word boundary and ends with an ellipsis (U+2026)

parent.description: Route of the parent navigation node, null at the top level. The parent is a page (a folder's README) or, where a folder has no README, a folder node that exists only in `nav` and has no PageEntry (for example `code`, `legal`)

order.description: Position among the siblings under the same parent, from 0; the same as the node's `order` in `nav`

group.description: Sidebar group label from a `###` heading in the parent folder's README; absent when the page has none

section.description: A page node has its page's section; a folder node (folder: true) takes the section of its first child

order.description: Position among its siblings, from 0; siblings are already listed in this order. The top level starts with the home page

folder.description: Present and true only for a node that has no page of its own (no PageEntry, no pages/<route>.md); absent for page nodes

group.description: Sidebar group label; absent when the node has none

children.description: Absent on a leaf, never an empty array

kind.description: The file extension, lower case. Only html and pdf exist today; the other values are possible when such a file is added under docs/ or blueprints/. No other value ever appears

version.description: 12 hex characters; changes whenever any page or asset changes. Use as the cache-busting query string

repo.description: GitHub repository URL used for links to non-page files; null when the build was given none

base.description: URL path the links were built for, no trailing slash

text.description: Plain text of the page, the first 4,000 characters (a raw cut-off, not a summary)
